Reka's Rho-1 puts text, video and robot control in one 19B model
https://theaipost.net/story/find-reka-rho-1/

Mistral says its new model beats Chinese rivals on cyber, without naming one
https://theaipost.net/story/find-mistral-cyber-model-abu-dhabi/

OpenAI's Kwon apologises to Australian inquiry over Medicare agent breach
https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-australia-hearing-kwon/

South Korea plans a $3.5bn state stake in a frontier AI model

Seoul proposes 4.7 trillion won (about $3.5 billion) in equity for frontier-model work from as early as March 2027, the Korea Herald reports. The contest would be open to start-ups.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-korea-frontier-ai-program/

Google Docs and Drive add native markdown editing, 9to5Google reports

Google says users can open, edit and comment on markdown files in Docs and Drive without converting them, with the rollout starting 5 October and taking up to 15 days.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-markdown-docs-drive/

Amazon adds Z.ai's 753B GLM 5.3 coding model to Bedrock

Amazon says Z.ai's 753-billion-parameter coding model is open to eligible enterprise customers on Bedrock, and Z.ai claims a 50 percent gain over GLM 5.2 on its own test.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-glm-5-3-bedrock/

OpenAI makes Codex Auto-review free for every ChatGPT sign-in

A second agent now watches Codex's first one for risky actions, free for anyone signed in with ChatGPT. The Codex poster @thsottiaux told users to run it instead of full access.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-codex-auto-review-free/

DeepSeek nears $12 billion round led by Tencent and CATL, Bloomberg reports
https://theaipost.net/story/find-deepseek-12b-round/

Kandinsky Lab releases open 29B model that generates video with synced audio
https://theaipost.net/story/find-kandinsky-6-video/

Amazon releases diffusion language model it says beats Qwen3 at 2.7x speed
https://theaipost.net/story/find-alodlm-amazon/

SemiAnalysis says Claude plans give about 5x the API value of OpenAI's
https://theaipost.net/story/find-semianalysis-subscriptions/

HackerRank opens Chakra, an AI interviewer that runs coding rounds on real repositories
https://theaipost.net/story/find-hackerrank-chakra/

T3 Code lets coding agents draw live visualizations inside the chat thread

Theo's T3 Code now lets agents build dynamic visualizations inside a thread, styled with the user's own theme. The maker's clip drew 969 likes in about an hour.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-t3-code-visualizations/

Anthropic staff gave $540m in 2025, five times the next corporate donor
https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-donations-ipo/

Researchers track an AI 'agent fleet' asking Amap for zoo directions

Researchers say many parallel AI agents, apparently on Tencent servers, query Alibaba's Amap for routes to a park, a zoo and a hospital. They see no sign the agents talk.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chinese-agent-fleet-amap/

Etched is reported to be fielding funding offers at a $40bn to $50bn valuation
https://theaipost.net/story/find-etched-funding-talks/
